title: A course pack's classify puzzle (courses/<id>/puzzles/<name>.json)
description: Sort each item into the bin it belongs in (crates by where the work runs, letters into the Settings cubbies, orders onto the flag that brings them). `bins` are the places in key order; `items` are what you sort, each with its answer and the reason a wrong pick gets; a `tray` is the 'none of these' bin. A puzzle the course runs has its mechanic's fields; a `"disabled": true` file needs none. Every puzzle file has an `id`, its `mechanic`, and may set `disabled` (the site stays as scenery), `text` (its words by key, `{name}` filled in by the game) and `lines` (its voice line ids by what they're for). docs/specs/COURSE-PACKS.md §4.

disabled.description: The course turns this puzzle off: its site stays as scenery and its cue does nothing.

text.description: The puzzle's words by key (labels, hints, readouts, signs).

lines.description: Voice line ids (voice/lines.json) by what they're for.

bins.description: The places, in key order: a list, or an object by kind.

items.description: What you sort, in the order it's handed over.

cites.description: The course sections the reasons paraphrase, by key (anchor, its hash in lock.json, the section's name), in `chapter`.

chapter.description: The chapter `cites` and the items' `section` anchors are in.
